conbody.p: Every page is framed the same way: a narrow rail down the left and one top bar across the top, so the work itself gets the rest of the screen. The frame is the same inside a project and on the workspace's own pages (Projects, workspace settings, workspace runs, What's new and platform admin); only the rail's buttons change.

ul.li:
The top bar reads left to right: the workspace switcher, the project switcher, the page you are on, the search across every project, Help, the notification bell and the account menu.
Switch workspace: click the workspace's name for the list of your workspaces, workspace settings and runs, and creating a company workspace.
Switch project: click the project's name (it reads All projects on a workspace page) for the workspace's projects. Choose one to open it at its Home; All projects opens the Projects page and + New project starts a project from wherever you are.

The rail inside a project has a button for each part of the project — Define, Verify, Plan and Agents — and links to Activity and Settings. Click a group to open its pages beside the rail (Define holds Home, Overview, Guided Definition, Requirements and Interviews, for example), then click the page. The group holding the page you are on is marked. The list closes when you arrive, or with Esc or a click anywhere else.
The rail on a workspace page lists the workspace's own pages: Projects, Runs (where the workspace has them), News (What's new), Admin for platform admins, and Settings.
Projects is at the top of the rail on every page and returns to all projects in the workspace.

conbody.p: On a phone there is no rail. On a workspace page the top bar holds the workspace switcher above the project switcher, with help, the bell and your account beside them. Inside a project the top bar names where you are in two lines: the project, small, above the page you are reading. The project menu opens from ☰ in the top bar, and a row of tabs along the bottom reaches the pages used most on the move: Overview, Reqs (Requirements), V&V and Review. More opens the menu as a page of its own: the project at the top (tap it for all projects), the workspace switcher, the project switcher and the search, then each group of pages as a list under its name (tap the name to fold the group away), Help, and under You your account menu and the bell.
